title: Temporal stability probe for mixed-precision rollouts
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Summary: Build an automated probe runner that validates temporal stability and drift sensitivity when rolling mixed-precision (FP8/INT8) quantization profiles into production. Goal is to detect transient and cumulative accuracy regressions that standard one-off acceptance tests miss, provide per-profile pass/fail gates, and integrate into CI/CD and Canary rollouts.

Background: We have many quantization artifacts (per-layer scales, asymmetric/power-of-two clamps, calibration tables) and multiple model variants. Existing quant acceptance focuses on static accuracy delta vs float on a fixed golden set. This ticket introduces a time-series and stress-based validation harness: replay bursts, simulate distribution shift, and record per-step drift metrics to decide safe rollout.

Scope: Probe runner that runs nightly and on PR for quant-profile changes, supports replay of production traces and synthetic perturbations, computes stability metrics (cumulative KL drift, peak-top-k-accuracy-drop, latency-aligned sampling), supports per-sequence and per-layer diagnostics, and produces a single verdict for gating. Integrate results into Console test-reporting dashboard and add automatic annotation to rollout controller for canary decisions.

Out-of-scope: Rewriting kernel-level quant impls, creating new calibration algorithms (we will use existing calibration outputs), or gated production rollback automation (only reporting + clear pass/fail signals).
acceptance_criteria: Probe runner executes on CI and nightly cadence with configurable workloads (production traces + synthetic shifts)
Computes and stores temporal metrics: cumulative KL divergence over sequence windows, moving-window top-1/3/5 accuracy, token-level perplexity delta, and per-layer activation drift scores
Provides a deterministic pass/fail gate per quant-profile using an adjustable thresholding policy with severity levels (warning/blocking)
Artifacts and diagnostics (sampled sequences showing worst-case divergence, activation histograms, per-layer heatmap) are uploaded to the Console report for each run
Probe results are surfaced on PRs and linked to the canary rollout UI so engineers can see stability verdict before promoting a profile
Unit/integration tests cover core scoring logic and at least one simulated distribution-shift scenario
